articles.title: From Empty Wall to Broadway: Andrew Lloyd Webber Plans a Musical About the 1911 Mona Lisa Heist
articles.summary: In 1911, the Mona Lisa vanished from the Louvre for over two years. Now, Andrew Lloyd Webber—the master of theatrical spectacle—is crafting a musical around the bizarre true story of the theft, the bumbling investigation, and the unlikely hero who pulled it off.

articles.title: Bobby Finke's 'Slow' Times Are Actually Right on Schedule—Here's Why
articles.summary: World record holder Bobby Finke clocked a 15:13 in the 1500 free last week, 43 seconds off his best. But history shows his in-season swims are notoriously misleading—he routinely drops massive time when tapered for championship meets.

articles.title: The Declaration of Independence Was Once Breaking News—and a Woman Risked Everything to Print It
articles.summary: Long before it was a hallowed artifact, the Declaration of Independence spread through messy, unpredictable channels. A new book reveals how colonists first encountered it—and highlights Mary Katharine Goddard, the only woman who printed it under her own name, risking charges of treason.
